prompts.title: Forma reciente · kinetic results
prompts.prompt: Scene 1 · Forma reciente (kind: form) for vertical 9:16, 6–10 seconds, carrying both editorial and statistical presentations with transitions matched to the spoken words. EDITORIAL VARIANT (kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis): full-bleed GoatLab charcoal #101412, headline in warm white #edf0e6 condensed uppercase, Spanish labels VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS; lime #c5ed74 codes Aston Villa FC, slate #8ca6bf codes Fenerbahçe SK. Stage the sequence: (0–2 s) title mask reveal with a lime rule; (2–4 s) both team names slide in from opposite edges and lock; (4–8 s) the three result words punch in one per beat with scale bounce, letter-spacing snap and a brief chromatic flicker; (8–10 s) settle on a single lock-up. Camera: slow push-in, then a two-degree tilt for tension; transitions between beats are hard cuts with lime diagonal wipes; exit scatters the glyphs into one thin lime rule. No axes and no sample claims in this variant. Lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. STATISTICAL VARIANT: grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline and one common count scale, two clusters of three bars, lime for Aston Villa FC and slate for Fenerbahçe SK, axis caption in Spanish labels reading partidos. Values {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for Aston Villa FC and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for Fenerbahçe SK, all on the same unit. Source annotation: source Bzzoiro, printed small in warm white at the top edge; sample annotation: sample of {{home.n}} partidos versus {{away.n}} partidos, with an explicit Spanish note if the two samples are unequal, never converted into rates. Entry: baseline draws first, then bars grow upward with a stagger; main comparison: paired bars sit side by side and the taller of each pair flashes lime for one beat; emphasis: value counters tick above the bars at the end of the growth; camera: gentle push-in on the tallest pair; exit: bars retract to the baseline as a slate divider closes. One focal point throughout, yellow subtitles in the lower quarter.

prompts.title: Goles a favor y en contra · pitch path
prompts.prompt: Scene 2 · Goles del sample (kind: goals) for vertical 9:16, 6–10 seconds, containing both editorial and statistical presentations with transitions timed to the narration. EDITORIAL VARIANT (illustrative football pitch and ball path): a stylised half-pitch drawn in GoatLab charcoal #101412 with warm white #edf0e6 line-work, no data axes. A lime #c5ed74 ball arcs from Aston Villa FC's side toward the goal, a slate #8ca6bf ball answers from Fenerbahçe SK's side, and the two paths cross mid-frame. Stages: (0–2 s) pitch lines draw on; (2–5 s) first ball path with a dotted trail and a soft impact flash on the net; (5–8 s) second ball path, mirrored, with Spanish labels GOLES A FAVOR and GOLES RECIBIDOS sliding in beside each trail; (8–10 s) both balls rest at centre and a lime rule underlines the title. Camera: slow orbit, then push toward the crossing point; transitions are a lime sweep wipe in and a charcoal dip to black out. No sample claims here. Lower quarter stays clear for permanent yellow subtitles. STATISTICAL VARIANT: paired horizontal bars for both teams on one shared scale and one unit, goles, baseline at the left edge; lime bars for Aston Villa FC, slate bars for Fenerbahçe SK, Spanish labels GOLES A FAVOR and GOLES RECIBIDOS, with team names as row headers in warm white. Values {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}} for Aston Villa FC, {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}} for Fenerbahçe SK, plotted against the identical scale so the comparison is unambiguous and clearly football context. Source annotation: source Bzzoior fixture feed printed in small type; sample annotation: sample of {{home.n}} partidos for Aston Villa FC and {{away.n}} partidos for Fenerbahçe SK, kept attached to the bars. Entry: axis and row labels fade, then bars extend rightward with stagger; main comparison: for each row the longer bar carries a lime tip and a value counter; emphasis: a single vertical marker slides to the largest bar and pulses once; camera: slow push-in; transitions: charcoal wipe between entry and lock-up; exit: bars slide left off-frame behind a slate divider. One focal point, yellow subtitles in the lower quarter.
